messages.subject: Project Tempest — term sheet countersigned
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel, Sarah,

Delighted — Marisdale has countersigned the term sheet, and Westbridge are in for their £6m. We're excited to lead this round. Oliver Jennings at Birchall Stone will run the legal for us; he'll be in touch with your team to kick off due diligence.

Let's aim for completion in early February.

Eleanor
